title.zh: Allium报告：前三季度稳定币支付规模达4820亿美元，同比增长45%
title.en: Allium报告：前三季度稳定币支付规模达4820亿美元，同比增长45%

current_state.zh: Allium's report shows stablecoin payment volume reached $482 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up 45% year over year, while transaction count rose 71% to over 1 billion and stablecoin-linked card spending hit $3.9 billion, 10x the prior year.
